heroTitle: Cloud POS Terminal with E-Receipt Integration
heroSubtitle: Engineered for retail chains, pharmacies, and supermarkets: lightning-fast checkouts, seamless offline operation, and certified e-receipt compliance.
visionTitle: Faster Customer Queues and Tighter Cash Control
visionDesc: Long checkout queues frustrate customers. USoft POS empowers your cashiers with snappy item scanning, instant pricing logic, and quick tender completion.

features.title: Ultra-Fast Touch-Screen Cashier Interface
features.desc: Streamlined UI designed to finalize customer sales in under 3 seconds with touch support, quick SKU search, and programmable hotkeys.

features.title: Uninterrupted Offline Mode Operation
features.desc: Keep processing transactions and printing receipts even when offline. System auto-synchronizes data seamlessly once connection restores.

features.title: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) E-Receipt Compliant
features.desc: Certified B2C electronic receipt issuance complying with Egyptian Tax Authority mandates with dynamic verification QR codes.

features.title: Shift Management & Cash Drawer Balancing
features.desc: Manage cashier shifts with opening float checks, mid-shift payouts, and end-of-day Z-Report reconciliation highlighting tender breakdowns.

features.title: Plug & Play Retail Hardware Compatibility
features.desc: Full integration with thermal printers, electronic cash drawers, wireless barcode scanners, and weighing scale barcode systems.

features.title: Multi-Tender Payments & Split Billing
features.desc: Support split transactions across cash, credit cards, mobile wallets, and customer credit ledger balances on the same receipt.

steps.title: Open Shift & Float
steps.desc: Cashier logs in and confirms opening cash balance.

steps.title: Scan & Cart Build
steps.desc: Scan barcode or select touch tiles with instant price pull.

steps.title: Payment & Receipt
steps.desc: Tender transaction and print certified ETA e-receipt.

steps.title: Shift Close & Sync
steps.desc: Print Z-report and post revenue and inventory decrements.

closingTitle: Ready to Modernize Your Retail Point of Sale?
closingDesc: Consult with our POS specialists to test-drive hardware compatibility and ETA e-receipt generation.
